recognize_zh: A、B 圖 H&E 可見成片組織細胞，胞質豐富、嗜伊紅、呈顆粒至纖維狀，間夾小型成熟漿細胞；C 圖 CD68 標出成片組織細胞，D 圖原位雜交顯示組織細胞與漿細胞都是 kappa 陽性、lambda（插圖）陰性，符合結晶貯積組織細胞症。
features: Sheets of large polygonal histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, granular to fibrillar cytoplasm effacing the core (A, B)
Small bland histiocyte nuclei with interspersed small mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei (B)
CD68 immunostain strongly highlights histiocytic sheets separated by CD68-negative plasma cells (C)
Kappa ISH positive in plasma cells (arrowhead) and histiocyte cytoplasm (arrow); lambda negative (inset) (D)
Discrete crystals are subtle at this magnification; no sheets of atypical plasma cells evident
describe_en: Core biopsy of a sternal mass shows diffuse sheets of large histiocytes with abundant eosinophilic, granular to fibrillar cytoplasm (A), with small bland nuclei and scattered interspersed small mature plasma cells (B). CD68 highlights the histiocytic sheets, separated by CD68-negative plasma cells (C). Kappa in situ hybridization is positive in both the plasma cells and the cytoplasm of the histiocytes, with lambda negative (D, inset), indicating monotypic kappa immunoglobulin stored within histiocytes. Individual crystals are not well resolved at this magnification. Findings are consistent with kappa-restricted crystal-storing histiocytosis; evaluation for an underlying plasma cell neoplasm, lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma or monoclonal gammopathy is required.

ddx.vs: Granular cell tumor is S100/SOX10 positive and rhabdomyoma is desmin/myogenin positive, and neither contains CD68-positive histiocytes with light-chain-restricted stored immunoglobulin.
Organism-laden histiocytes are foamy or striated with acid-fast/PAS-positive bacilli and show no monotypic light-chain staining.
These have wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm (PAS positive, glucocerebroside) rather than eosinophilic crystalline kappa-positive material.
Langerhans cells have grooved folded nuclei with admixed eosinophils and express CD1a/langerin/S100, lacking abundant eosinophilic crystalline cytoplasm.
